messages:
peter: NorthBridge support submitted a billing dispute. They were charged a pro-rated reserved pool fee for May even though they downgraded mid-cycle. Invoice INV-2026-0529-211 shows PRO-RATED-RESERVED $5,600. They request $2,800 refund for the unused half-month.
northbridge-support: Confirmed. Our portal shows downgrade on 2026-05-16 but invoice charged full month. Screenshot attached.
eli: Can you paste invoice lines? Also need to know if billing-cycle proration is enabled on their contract.
peter: Invoice lines: RESERVED-GPU-POOL (May) qty 1 $5,600.00. Account metadata flagged proration=true but a job failed to apply proration tag at billing run.
nina: Since requested refund is $2,800 (>=$2.5k but >$5k? it's below $5k), finance manager approval fine. However we need an engineering task to fix billing job and an audit memo.
maria: I need a short justification and confirmation this is a platform error. Also add account owner approval.
legal-bot: Auto-note: refunds <=$5k do not require legal per FIN-REF-3.
eli: ENG-TASK-2026-621 created to investigate proration job failure and add retry. Assigned eng-billing.
peter: Account owner Sam approved DM: "Please apply the pro-rated refund, thanks." Pasting here.
nina: I'll run the billing-tool steps once I get final confirmation:
```nbilling-tool credit-create --customer cust_7NBH --invoice INV-2026-0529-211 --amount 2800.00 --currency USD --reason "Prorated reserved pool refund (May)" --gl-code REV-ADJ
billing-tool refund-issue --customer cust_7NBH --amount 2800.00 --method stripe --note "Pro-rata refund for reserved pool downgrade"
```
(finance-bot will record txn)
finance-bot: Policy check passed. Creating ledger memo referencing ENG-TASK-2026-621.
maria: Approved. Nina, proceed and paste the transaction id when issued.
nina: Credit memo cm_aa12f created. Refund txn refund_txn_9d4b2 queued, pending_settlement. Added audit note linking ENG-TASK-2026-621.
northbridge-support: Thank you. We'll confirm settlement with the customer and close the ticket.
peter: Closing thread: pro-rata refund processed, ENG-TASK-2026-621 open for root cause. Thanks team :thumbsup:
